headline: European Gas Prices Rise as Cold Snap Hits Reserves
summary: European natural gas prices at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF) rose for the fourth consecutive day, topping 90.50 euros per MWh. A cold snap is accelerating withdrawals from storage levels that were already at multi-year lows.
why: The TTF is the primary benchmark for European natural gas, and price spikes directly impact energy costs for households and industrial production across the continent.
why_moved: Increased heating demand during a cold snap combined with low starting inventory levels is putting upward pressure on prices.
